films.line_mk: Брзо, топло, и секогаш многу вкусно.
films.line_en: Fast, hot, and always very tasty.
films.desc_en: A high-energy social media reel capturing the sizzling street food culture and fast delivery of Skopje.
films.music: Upbeat modern hip-hop instrumental with heavy bass, 110 bpm.
vo_mk: Вкусот на чаршијата, сега директно кај вас!

shots.kf: Extreme close-up, vertical 9:16 framing. A juicy, thick meat patty sizzling on a cast-iron grill. Bright orange flames lick the edges of the meat. Dark background, dramatic side lighting highlighting the smoke and texture. Shot on 85mm macro lens, rich warm color palette, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The flames flicker rapidly around the edges of the patty while the camera slowly pushes in towards the sizzling meat.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 framing. A generic bright yellow delivery scooter zooms past a blurred background of the Skopje Kale fortress. The rider wears a matching yellow jacket and black helmet with a dark visor. Golden hour sunlight, dynamic motion blur, cinematic 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The scooter drives forward through the frame while the camera pans quickly to track its movement against the blurred background.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 framing. A traditional ornate copper tray holding a small ceramic cup of steaming Turkish coffee and a powdered cube of lokum. The tray sits on a rustic wooden table. Soft morning sunlight streams from the side, deep shadows, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick steam rises gently from the coffee cup while the camera slowly glides upwards over the rustic wooden table.

films.line_mk: Создадено со многу љубов и вистинска страст.
films.line_en: Created with much love and true passion.
films.desc_en: A poetic and atmospheric brand film highlighting the emotional and artisanal side of high-end dining.
films.music: Slow, emotional acoustic guitar and warm cello melody, 65 bpm.
vo_mk: Секој рецепт крие една многу тајна приказна.
Спомени вткаени во секој топол вкусен залак.
Вкуси ја магијата на нашиот прекрасен дом.

shots.kf: Wide shot, 16:9 framing. A cozy, elegant café interior in Skopje. Empty leather booths, exposed brick walls, and a sleek espresso machine. Warm amber pendant lights glow softly. Morning sunlight filters through large windows, illuminating dust motes. Cinematic 24mm lens, deep shadows, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pushes forward down the center aisle of the café, gliding smoothly past the empty leather booths.

shots.kf: Close-up, 16:9 framing. A chef's arm in a crisp white sleeve holds a heavy black frying pan, tossing bright red peppers and onions. A burst of yellow fire illuminates the dark kitchen background. High contrast, cinematic lighting, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The vegetables fly up into the air in slow motion as the flames flare up, with a subtle camera tilt.

shots.kf: Macro shot, 16:9 framing. A beautifully plated modern gourmet dish on a dark ceramic plate, featuring sliced roasted meat and vibrant green herb oil. Steaming hot. Placed on a dark slate table. Directional spotlighting, shallow depth of field, 100mm macro lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly rotates around the plate, keeping the steaming roasted meat perfectly in focus against the blurred background.

shots.kf: Close-up, 16:9 framing. A stream of velvety steamed milk pouring into a dark brown ceramic cup filled with rich espresso, forming an elegant abstract white swirl. The cup rests on an oak counter. Soft backlighting, warm tones, 85mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The milk continuously flows into the cup, swirling beautifully, while the camera subtly pushes in for a tighter view.

shots.kf: Medium close-up, 16:9 framing. Two elegant crystal wine glasses filled with deep ruby red wine stand on a white tablecloth. In the softly blurred background, warm candle flames flicker. Luxurious atmosphere, rich crimson and gold color palette, 50mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The two wine glasses gently clink together, causing ripples in the red wine, while the camera holds perfectly still.

shots.kf: Wide exterior shot, 16:9 framing. A charming restaurant facade at twilight in the Old Bazaar. Cobblestone street in the foreground. Overhead warm string lights glow brightly against the deep blue evening sky. No readable text. Atmospheric, cinematic 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly cranes upwards, revealing more of the glowing string lights and the beautiful dark blue twilight sky.

films.line_mk: Од празна маса до вистинско кулинарско богатство.
films.line_en: From an empty table to a true culinary treasure.
films.desc_en: A mesmerizing timelapse-style video showcasing the creation of a meal from raw ingredients to a beautiful dining experience.
films.music: Rhythmic clock-ticking beat building into orchestral swell, 90 bpm.
vo_mk: Следете го патот на совршениот македонски оброк.
Уживајте во секој прекрасен и вкусен момент.

shots.kf: Medium shot, 16:9 framing. An empty rustic wooden dining table located in a sunlit, elegant restaurant room. In the center sits a stark white, completely empty ceramic plate, flanked by perfectly aligned polished silver cutlery. Bright natural morning daylight creates soft, long shadows. Cinematic 50mm lens, highly photorealistic and pristine.
shots.end_kf: Medium shot, 16:9 framing. The same rustic wooden dining table in the sunlit restaurant. The white plate is now overflowing with a vibrant, colorful traditional Macedonian Shopska salad, generously topped with fluffy grated white cheese. A glass of chilled water sits nearby. Cinematic 50mm lens, highly photorealistic and appetizing.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pushes forward toward the table while the empty plate smoothly morphs into the fully prepared fresh salad.

shots.kf: Top-down view, 16:9 framing. Thick, raw, heavily seasoned cuts of premium beef resting on a cold, dark, heavy cast-iron grill grate. The coals underneath are completely black and unlit. Moody, dark cinematic lighting, highly textured surface, 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Top-down view, 16:9 framing. The same cuts of premium beef, now perfectly grilled and seared with deep, dark char marks. The heavy cast-iron grill grate sits above brightly glowing, intense red-hot coals. Plumes of light smoke rise. Moody cinematic lighting, 35mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera maintains a fixed overhead angle, slowly rotating clockwise as the raw meat gradually transforms into perfectly cooked steak.

shots.kf: Close-up, 16:9 framing. A clear, plain glass coffee cup resting on a dark marble countertop. Inside the cup, there is only a mound of dry, dark brown, coarse coffee grounds. Soft ambient lighting, cool color palette, shallow depth of field, 85mm macro lens, highly photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Close-up, 16:9 framing. The same clear glass coffee cup on the dark marble countertop. The cup is now completely filled with rich, dark liquid espresso, topped with a thick, golden-brown bubbly crema. Delicate wisps of steam rise gently. Warm lighting, 85mm macro lens, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly dollies to the left, keeping the cup perfectly centered as the dry grounds magically dissolve into hot espresso.

shots.kf: Wide shot, 16:9 framing. A dark, completely empty restaurant dining room. The tables are set but unlit, featuring unlit candles and empty wine glasses. The ambient light is a cold, twilight blue coming from the windows. Deep shadows, silent atmosphere, 24mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.end_kf: Wide shot, 16:9 framing. The same restaurant dining room, now fully illuminated and vibrant. Every table features brightly glowing, warm yellow candles. The wine glasses gleam under the golden light, creating a welcoming, luxurious atmosphere. Deep shadows contrast with warm highlights, 24mm lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera executes a very slow tilt upwards as the cold, dark room seamlessly transforms into a warm, inviting environment.

films.desc_en: A warm and inviting commercial capturing the quiet magic of a morning coffee ritual in a leafy Skopje neighborhood.
films.music: Gentle acoustic guitar and light percussion, warm, 85 bpm
vo_mk: Градот се буди со првите зраци.
Ти треба момент само за тебе.
Ние го создаваме со многу љубов.

shots.kf: A 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair tied back, wearing a crisp white shirt and a dark green apron. She is in a sunlit café interior standing behind a wooden counter. Morning sunlight streams through unseen windows. 35mm lens, cinematic depth of field, mid shot, rule of thirds. Warm earth tones, soft greens, golden hour highlights, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman gently wipes the wooden counter with a clean cloth. The camera slowly pans right, following her subtle movement.

shots.kf: A 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair tied back, wearing a crisp white shirt and a dark green apron. She stands next to a gleaming metallic espresso machine. Soft interior lighting mixed with daylight. 50mm lens, medium close-up focused on her calm expression. Dark greens, silver, warm brown, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman places her hand softly on the espresso machine lever. The camera slowly pushes in towards her face.

shots.kf: Rich dark espresso coffee pouring into a textured ceramic cup resting on the metal drip tray of an espresso machine. Focused spotlight on the cup. 85mm macro lens, extreme close-up, center framed. Deep browns, silver, warm beige, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A thick, syrupy stream of espresso flows continuously into the ceramic cup. The camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A 30-year-old woman with curly brown hair tied back, wearing a crisp white shirt and a dark green apron. She stands behind the café counter. Bright, flattering ambient light. 50mm lens, mid shot, eye level. Greens, whites, warm oak, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman turns her head slightly towards the lens and offers a warm, subtle smile. The camera slowly tracks backward.

shots.kf: A steaming ceramic cup of coffee sitting on a wooden table next to a window with blurred autumn leaves outside. Soft, diffused daylight. 50mm lens, close-up, slightly high angle. Warm beige, autumn oranges, dark wood, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Soft steam rises gently from the surface of the hot coffee. The camera slowly pans left across the wooden table.

films.line_en: The true taste of our tradition.
films.desc_en: A cozy and appetizing commercial focusing on the rich, bubbling warmth of traditional Macedonian comfort food served in a rustic setting.
films.music: Slow acoustic folk instrumental, warm, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Кога студот ќе затропа на вратата.
Подготвено на стариот, добро познат начин.
Мирис кој ги враќа најубавите спомени.

shots.kf: A rustic terracotta clay pot filled with baked beans, topped with a single dried red pepper. It sits on a wooden preparation table lightly dusted with flour. Moody, directional side light. 50mm lens, close-up, center framed. Rich terracotta, deep reds, dark brown, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Tiny motes of flour dust float slowly in the air around the pot. The camera slowly pans right across the wooden surface.

shots.kf: A rustic terracotta clay pot filled with baked beans, topped with a single dried red pepper, placed inside a traditional stone oven. Glowing embers sit in the background. Warm, fiery orange illumination. 85mm lens, medium close-up. Fiery oranges, blacks, terracotta, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Soft, out-of-focus flames flicker continuously in the background. The camera slowly pushes in towards the clay pot.

shots.kf: A rustic terracotta clay pot filled with baked beans, topped with a single dried red pepper, inside a hot stone oven. Bright, golden, intense heat lighting. 100mm macro lens, extreme close-up of the surface. Golden brown, deep red, burnt orange, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick bean sauce bubbles gently and rhythmically near the edges of the pot. The camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A rustic terracotta clay pot filled with baked beans, topped with a single dried red pepper, sitting in the center of a wooden kafana table with a red checkered tablecloth. Warm, cozy indoor pendant lighting. 35mm lens, wide shot, slightly high angle. Red, white, dark oak, terracotta, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick, warm steam rises heavily from the hot pot into the cozy room. The camera slowly tracks left around the table.

shots.kf: A rustic terracotta clay pot filled with baked beans, topped with a single dried red pepper, resting on a wooden table against a dark, blurred background. Soft, appetizing overhead spotlight. 85mm lens, close-up, low angle highlighting the crust. Golden crust, deep red pepper, dark background, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A gentle wisp of steam floats upwards from the glossy, roasted bean crust. The camera slowly tilts up to reveal the red pepper.
